sahihInternational: So he will be in a pleasant life -
yusufAli: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
urdu: پس وہ (شخص) من مانے عیش میں ہوگا

sahihInternational: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
yusufAli: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
urdu: اپنے پروردگار کی طرف لوٹ چل۔ تو اس سے راضی وہ تجھ سے راضی

sahihInternational: He will be in a pleasant life.
yusufAli: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
